title: Tailwise Grooming Salon Courtesy — Overdue Tailwise Plus Fee (Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus)
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus.** A salon courtesy — a flat dollar amount — is subtracted from the overdue fee collected to reinstate a past-due Tailwise Plus Annual or Tailwise Plus Premier Annual membership, according to the customer's Tailwise Grooming Salon records: whether the customer holds an active grooming pass, and the date of the customer's latest completed grooming visit.

**Rule.** A customer holding an active grooming pass whose latest completed visit was at most 60 calendar days before the collection date: $2.00. A customer holding an active grooming pass without such a visit: $1.00. A customer holding no active grooming pass: no salon courtesy.

| Active grooming pass | Latest completed visit, counted back from the collection date | Salon courtesy |
|---|---|---|
| held | 60 days or fewer | $2.00 |
| held | more than 60 days, or none | $1.00 |
| not held | any | none |

**Both sides (hypothetical, collection on 31 August, active pass held).** Latest completed visit on 2 July (60 days before): $2.00. On 1 July (61 days before): $1.00.
